"import cadquery as cq

# Sketch plane: "XZ" so local (u, v) maps to global (x, y, z) = (u, 0, v)
P = cq.Plane.named("XZ")

def pt(u, v):
    """Map local sketch coordinates (mm) to world coordinates."""
    return P.toWorldCoords((u, v))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entity 1: Line from (28, 0) to (0, -18)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
A = pt(28, 0)
B = pt(0, -18)
edge1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(A, B)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entity 2: Line from (0, -18) to (-28, 0)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
C = pt(-28, 0)
edge2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(B, C)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entity 3: Fitted spline through the fit points (smooth, no kinks)
#           (-28, 0), (-14, 21), (0, 26), (14, 21), (28, 0)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
spline_points = [
    pt(-28, 0),
    pt(-14, 21),
    pt(0, 26),
    pt(14, 21),
    pt(28, 0),
]
edge3 = cq.Edge.makeSpline(spline_points)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assemble: exactly 3 edges forming exactly 1 closed profile
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
edges = [edge1, edge2, edge3]
assert len(edges) == 3

# Sanity check: junctions coincident (within tolerance) -> single closed loop
tol = 1e-6
assert (edge1.startPoint() - A).Length < tol
assert (edge1.endPoint() - B).Length < tol
assert (edge2.startPoint() - B).Length < tol
assert (edge2.endPoint() - C).Length < tol
assert (edge3.startPoint() - spline_points[0]).Length < tol
assert (edge3.endPoint() - spline_points[-1]).Length < tol

# Sanity check: all vertices lie on the XZ plane (global y == 0)
for v in (A, B, C) + tuple(spline_points):
    assert abs(v.y) < tol

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export compound of edges to STEP
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
compound = cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges)
cq.exporters.export(compound, "sketch.step")"
